prompt:
Our bioinformatics team needs a reactive build system for our genomic analysis pipeline at /workspace. Whenever any Python source file inside the src/ directory changes, we need the system to automatically regenerate a checksum manifest at results/tables/checksums.md5 (listing MD5 hashes of all .py files in src/) and append a timestamped status line to build_log.txt at the project root.

To prove the system works end-to-end: set up the file watcher using the build_manifest.sh script already in the project root, trigger it by modifying at least one of the existing Python source files in src/, and confirm that both build_log.txt and the manifest were updated reactively.

The watcher should run in the background so you can trigger the file change and observe the result without being blocked.
